```{r}
A7_070_threshold_calibration <- readRDS(here::here("R_objects", "A7_070_threshold_calibration.rds"))
cal <- A7_070_threshold_calibration
gp  <- cal$grid_position
pct <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * x)
cut_txt <- function(x) ifelse(x %% 1 == 0, sprintf("%d", as.integer(x)), sprintf("%.1f", x))
```

# Cut points and calibration check

The Core algorithm uses T < `r cut_txt(cal$cuts[["severe"]])` (severe) and T < `r cut_txt(cal$cuts[["moderate"]])` (moderate). These cut points were set in April 2026 so that the survey-weighted (`r cal$weight`) Normal, MCI, and Dementia shares of the Core algorithm approximate those of the HRS/HCAP Algorithm (`r cal$target_variable`) in HCAP 2016 (N = `r format(cal$n_sample, big.mark = ",")`). They are the cut points in the classification file shared on 2026-07-10.

Target shares: Normal `r pct(cal$target_shares[["1"]])`, MCI `r pct(cal$target_shares[["2"]])`, Dementia `r pct(cal$target_shares[["3"]])`. At the algorithm cut points the Core shares are `r pct(cal$algorithm$share_normal)`, `r pct(cal$algorithm$share_mci)`, and `r pct(cal$algorithm$share_dementia)`.

As a check, a grid search (step `r cal$grid_step` T points, `r format(gp$n_pairs, big.mark = ",")` pairs, memory and IQCODE rules fixed) finds the pair whose shares are closest to the target (sum of squared differences). The grid optimum is T < `r cut_txt(cal$calibrated_cuts[["severe"]])` and T < `r cut_txt(cal$calibrated_cuts[["moderate"]])`. The algorithm cut points rank `r gp$rank` of `r format(gp$n_pairs, big.mark = ",")` pairs; their largest difference from a target share is `r sprintf("%.1f", 100 * gp$max_abs_share_diff_algorithm)` percentage points, against `r sprintf("%.1f", 100 * gp$max_abs_share_diff_calibrated)` at the grid optimum.

```{r}
#| tbl-cap: "Algorithm, grid-optimum, and kappa-maximizing cut points (in-sample)"
#| label: tbl-a7-070-cuts
dplyr::bind_rows(
  cal$algorithm  |> dplyr::mutate(set = "Algorithm"),
  cal$calibrated |> dplyr::mutate(set = "Grid optimum (prevalence matching)"),
  cal$max_kappa  |> dplyr::mutate(set = "Maximum 3-class kappa")
) |>
  dplyr::select(set, cut_severe, cut_moderate, share_normal, share_mci,
                share_dementia, kappa_3class, kappa_binary) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::fmt_percent(columns = dplyr::starts_with("share"), decimals = 1) |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = dplyr::starts_with("kappa"), decimals = 3) |>
  gt::cols_label(set = "", cut_severe = "Severe cut", cut_moderate = "Moderate cut",
                 share_normal = "Normal", share_mci = "MCI", share_dementia = "Dementia",
                 kappa_3class = "Kappa (3-class, quadratic)", kappa_binary = "Kappa (dementia)")
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Weighted dementia share by severe cut point (left) and MCI share by moderate cut point at the algorithm's severe cut (right). Dashed lines: HRS/HCAP Algorithm shares. Solid grey lines: algorithm cut points."
#| label: fig-a7-070-curves
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4
curves <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  cal$grid |>
    dplyr::group_by(cut = cut_severe) |>
    dplyr::summarise(share = dplyr::first(share_dementia), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::mutate(panel = "Dementia share by severe cut"),
  cal$grid |>
    dplyr::filter(cut_severe == cal$cuts[["severe"]]) |>
    dplyr::transmute(cut = cut_moderate, share = share_mci,
                     panel = "MCI share by moderate cut")
)
refs <- tibble::tibble(
  panel  = c("Dementia share by severe cut", "MCI share by moderate cut"),
  target = c(cal$target_shares[["3"]], cal$target_shares[["2"]]),
  cut    = c(cal$cuts[["severe"]], cal$cuts[["moderate"]])
)
ggplot(curves, aes(cut, share)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(data = refs, aes(yintercept = target), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(data = refs, aes(xintercept = cut), colour = "grey50") +
  facet_wrap(~panel, scales = "free") +
  scale_y_continuous("Weighted share", labels = scales::percent) +
  xlab("Cut point (T score)")
```
